title: Camp trail snack, one rule
storyboard: Film: overhead of kids mixing trail snack in steel tins at camp; guide sealing pouches before the walk (2 shots)
caption:
The secret ingredient is self-control.

In the same study, fed macaques also moved shorter distances each day and dropped seeds on roads, where they rarely grow.
